zones.label: Carbohydrates
zones.summary: Carbohydrates are the body’s main source of quick, ready energy.
facts: Grains, fruit, vegetables, and many other foods contain carbohydrates.
The brain and moving muscles regularly use this energy.
Carbohydrates are teammates, not foods to fear.

zones.label: Protein
zones.summary: Protein supplies building material for growth and repair.
facts: Beans, eggs, fish, dairy, tofu, nuts, and other foods can contribute protein.
Growing bodies repair muscle and other tissue every day.
Families meet protein needs through many food traditions.

zones.label: Fats
zones.summary: Fats provide longer-lasting energy and help the body absorb certain vitamins.
facts: Nuts, seeds, avocado, and oils are familiar sources.
The body needs fats in a balanced pattern.
Fats are not the enemy; they have distinct jobs.

zones.label: Hydration
zones.summary: Water supports temperature control, circulation, thinking, and movement.
facts: Drink before, during, and after activity.
Needs change with heat, duration, and intensity.
Most ordinary activity does not require a sugary or caffeinated drink.

quiz.question: Which teammate supplies quick, ready energy?
Which teammate helps build and repair body tissues?
Which teammate offers longer-lasting energy and helps absorb vitamins?
Which teammate supports cooling and fluid balance during activity?
